budget.student_loss_token_exposures: measured separately; onpolicy variable lengths vs cached 7 tokens, same row/update budget does not imply token/compute matching

claim_boundary: One predeclared fixed-expert hybrid and two matched controls on known Sequence303 mappings, one learner seed and reused previously observed TEST/unused inputs. Native whole answer plus EOS evaluates persistent task adapters after separate-job reload, not broad continual learning, native-base consolidation, autonomous composition, or SDFT/SDPO reproduction. Generic retention is separate original multiple-choice likelihood scoring. Greedy teacher qualification certifies native answers on TRAIN/VAL only, not arbitrary student prefixes. KL and SFT have different objectives and trajectory lengths. No superiority claim before actual completed training and teacher-absent fresh-process evaluation.
failure_action: Reject native teacher prerequisite before learner loading/updates. Abort nonfinite/support loss/changed teacher/base/source/checkpoint/schedule. Preserve partial trajectories and update logs. No fallback to labels, vocabulary filtering, teacher EMA, budget extension or checkpoint selection.

method_provenance.implemented: Forward full-vocabulary KL on fresh student trajectories as a fixed-expert hybrid; cached-trajectory KL and cached-answer SFT controls. Independent teacher and learner on identical pinned base; same raw task prompt. Teacher parameters frozen and detached; sample identities detached, semi-gradient update, no score-function estimator. Native sampled EOS participates in loss, cap adds no EOS. Token softmax sampling float64 to verify positive numerical support; model/loss FP32. No forced termination, top-k/top-p, special-token suppression, answer-code vocabulary reduction, demonstration-conditioned teacher, teacher EMA or teacher optimization.
inspected_sections: Algorithm1 (on-policy sampled prefixes, demonstration-conditioned EMA teacher)
method_provenance.title: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning

predeclared_prefix_audit.summaries: per checkpoint interval1-32/33-128/129-384 and task: sampled native whole-answer/format/EOS, prefix match rate, teacher next-token agreement only on matched prefixes, divergent-prefix entropy/EOS mass/teacher logp of sampled token, KL and token counts
predeclared_prefix_audit.teacher_claim: No correctness label for arbitrary off-answer prefixes; descriptive teacher distributions there do not qualify competent correction.

prefix_diagnostics: Store every sampled token and prefix, student/teacher argmax, full-support minima, sampled-token probabilities, teacher entropy/EOS probability, forward KL by token, and matched-correct-prefix next-token agreement. Full generated grade describes student sampling only. After divergence the qualified answer supplies no correctness label for expert next tokens. No claim of off-answer prefix competence; no filtering, repair or recipe selection from these diagnostics.

retention.scorer: frozen choice_consolidation encode_choices/candidate_logps with original candidate cardinality; raw prompt/no chat, preserved boundary, no EOS, summed full-vocabulary logp divided by answer characters, argmax first tie, candidate batch8 FP32 maxprompt768

runtime_dependency.numerical_boundary: Replacement-worker gate qualifies BF16 vendor-runtime loading only. These experiments preserve the frozen coverage learner FP32 full-base path; each teacher/student/evaluator explicitly verifies FP32, one ROCm GPU, finite tensors, actual all-tensor residency, no offload hooks, pinned model snapshot and full base tensor hash. Gate is not FP32 numerical parity or capability proof.
